projectBackground.name: Workforce Restructure — Halden Logistics
projectBackground.context: Halden plans to reduce headcount and has also received an overtime pay query from a driver.

manager.name: Rachel Osei
manager.note: Process matters as much as outcome. If it isn't fair and documented, it isn't safe.

assignment.title: Advise on notice, pay and process
assignment.brief: Calculate notice, holiday and overtime, advise on fair dismissal and redundancy, and write the advice letter.

documents.name: Employee Record
documents.note: Employee with six years' service; 28 days annual holiday; leaves after 5 months of the year.

documents.name: Pay Query
documents.note: Overtime 8 hours at 1.5x; base €15 per hour.

documents.name: Restructure Plan
documents.note: Eight roles at risk; selection criteria undefined.

tasks.title: Statutory Notice
tasks.prompt: Statutory notice is 1 week per full year of service (max 12). Six years' service. How many weeks?
tasks.tip: Use the more generous of contract and statute.
tasks.mistake: Using one week regardless of service is wrong.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Accrued Holiday
tasks.prompt: 28 days a year; employee leaves after 5 months. How many days have accrued (2 decimals)?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Overtime Pay
tasks.prompt: Base €15/hour, overtime at 1.5x, 8 hours. What is the overtime pay (€)?
tasks.reasoning: Check the contract and law for rates.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Fair Dismissal
tasks.prompt: Which approach to dismissal is safest?
options: A fair reason, a fair procedure and a right of appeal
tasks.reasoning: Fair reason plus fair process reduces claims.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Fair Redundancy
tasks.prompt: Select elements of a fair redundancy process.
tasks.reasoning: Redundancy needs reason, criteria and consultation.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Advice Letter
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence advice summary for the client.
tasks.modelAnswer: Halden may proceed with redundancies only with a genuine business reason, objective selection criteria set before choosing individuals, and consultation on alternatives. The departing employee with six years' service is owed six weeks' notice and 11.67 days' accrued holiday. The overtime query is valid: 8 hours at 1.5x equals €180 and should be paid. We recommend we draft the selection matrix and consultation plan this week.
tasks.reasoning: A good letter answers the questions asked and states the next step.
tasks.mistake: Legal answers without next steps leave clients stuck.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Email Dismissal
caseStudy.background: An employer dismissed a long-serving employee by text message after a rumour. A tribunal found it unfair and awarded 18 months' pay.
caseStudy.solution: Kestrel introduced a dismissal checklist: investigation, hearing, decision, appeal.
